g.text: HIBEEX is a fintech startup with full AI back-office services for Brazil's small businesses. Our AI agents
connect to the old software a business already pays for, then do the manual work on top: taxes, forms, insurance
It began inside my father's dental clinic. At 14, after he had to let his staff go, I took over its accounting
and finances and built tools to save my parents time. After four years of that and 96 conversations with owners
in the same situation, my co-founder Teodoro and I made it a company (February 2026).
As co-founder I do code and business: sales, fundraising, finance and law. I built the multi-agent pipeline
(TypeScript, AWS, Next.js) that runs 23 workflows at 94% accuracy on site at 2 clients. So far: 42 clients, 73%
less manual work, and a US$100K investment offer. We moved to Sao Paulo in April, worked inside a client's
office from July, and since October build out of Ithaca, Taqtile's house, where co-founder Edmar Miyake mentors
